summary.key_theme: 市場對 Palo Alto Networks 在 AI 安全領域的領導地位與即將公布的財報抱持高度樂觀，多家券商上調目標價。

bullish.title: Benchmark Maintains Buy on Palo Alto Networks, Raises Price Target to $400
bullish.reason: 分析師 Yi Fu Lee 上調目標價至 $400，反映市場對其 AI 安全產品組合的強勁成長預期。

bullish.title: JP Morgan Maintains Overweight on Palo Alto Networks, Raises Price Target to $384
bullish.reason: 摩根大通分析師 Brian Essex 維持增持評級並上調目標價，顯示機構投資人對其長期獲利能力的信心。

bullish.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Signed A Multi Year AI Security Partnership
bullish.reason: 簽署多年期 AI 安全合作夥伴協議，直接強化了公司在 AI 驅動資安市場的競爭護城河。

bullish.title: Why Is Palo Alto Networks Stock Surging Thursday? — Palo Alto Networks (PANW) stock jumps 3% as CrowdStrike earnings spark a cybersecurity rally.
bullish.reason: 受同業 CrowdStrike 財報利多帶動，整個資安板塊出現連動上漲，顯示市場對資安需求前景看好。

bullish.title: BTIG Reiterates Buy on Palo Alto Networks, Maintains $380 Price Target
bullish.reason: BTIG 重申買入評級，進一步鞏固了市場對該股在財報公布前的正面預期。

bearish.title: Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora Warns Memory ‘Supercycle’ Will Eventually Turn Cyclical, Flagging Risk For Micron, SanDisk
bearish.reason: CEO 對記憶體產業發出週期性風險警告，雖非針對 PANW 本身，但可能引發市場對供應鏈成本波動的擔憂。

neutral.title: Is Palo Alto Networks Priced for Perfection Again as AI Security Demand Accelerates?
neutral.reason: 分析師提醒股價已反映高度預期，財報表現需證明 AI 故事的真實獲利能力，市場情緒轉為觀望。

neutral.title: Palo Alto Networks: Upcoming Earnings Beat, Valuation Is Crazy
neutral.reason: 指出營收成長強勁但 EPS 成長受限，對當前高估值提出質疑，多空觀點並存。
